description: This file defines a custom assertion class for JsonObject, extending AssertJ's assertion capabilities to facilitate fluent testing of JSON structures, including size, key containment, value verification, and comparison ignoring field definitions.

classes.name: JsonObjectAssert
classes.description: A specialized assertion class for verifying properties and contents of JsonObject instances in tests.

methods.name: hasSize
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonObject has the expected size.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Various overloads to verify JsonObject contains specific key-value pairs, values for keys, or fields at JSON pointers.

methods.name: doesNotContain
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonObject does not contain a specific key or field defined by a JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks that the JsonObject matches expected fields, with options to ignore field definitions.

methods.name: isEqualToIgnoringFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Checks equality while ignoring field definitions.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonObject contains specified keys.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is an array.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not an array.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is an object.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not an object.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a boolean.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is null.

methods.name: isNotNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not null.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a number.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a number.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a string.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a string.

methods.name: doesNotSupport
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue does not support a specific operation via Consumer.
